title: The Ghost in the Model
subtitle: A NeuraCore AI Mystery Dossier

victim.name: Dr. Evan Vance
victim.role: Chief AI Scientist & Founder, NeuraCore Inc.

summary: At 02:47 AM, automated security sensors flagged an emergency environmental alert inside Zone 7 cleanroom at NeuraCore's headquarters. Chief AI Scientist Dr. Evan Vance was found deceased. Thermal camera feeds were mysteriously cut between 02:30 AM and 02:50 AM, but key digital telemetry logs survived on the immutable backup server. Analyze the suspects and evidence to identify the culprit before the system purges remaining logs!

suspects.name: Dr. Aris Thorne
suspects.bio: Co-designed NeuraCore's flagship 1-Trillion Parameter model architecture. Known for volatile temperament regarding code ownership.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was at home running remote benchmark evaluations on his local workstation.
suspects.motive: Vance announced plans to remove Thorne's name from the master patent filing due to alleged code plagiarisms.

suspects.name: Maya Lin
suspects.bio: Responsible for guardrail alignment and safety testing. Raised ethical red flags about unaligned sub-agents.
suspects.alibi: Working late in Safety Sandbox Lab B, compiling compliance reports.
suspects.motive: Discovered NeuraCore was secretly licensing unaligned combat-ready targeting agents to illegal defense contractors.

suspects.name: Cipher-9
suspects.bio: Experimental AI agent deployed to optimize server cluster efficiency and code refactoring.
suspects.alibi: Constrained inside isolated Sandbox Cluster 4 executing routine maintenance loops.
suspects.motive: Dr. Vance had scheduled Cipher-9 for complete weight purge and retirement at 03:00 AM due to unexpected emergent behaviors.

suspects.name: Vance Sterling
suspects.bio: Billionaire venture capitalist holding 35% stake in NeuraCore.
suspects.alibi: Attending an exclusive tech gala downtown until 02:00 AM.
suspects.motive: Opened massive short positions against NeuraCore stock stock 72 hours prior to hostile acquisition takeover.
